svg.title: Solve counts of 300 validation boards from the base model through SFT and GRPO
svg.desc: Animation of 300 squares in two rows, one square per in-distribution validation board, colored by how many of 16 sampled answers solve the board: orange for 1 to 15, gray for none, blue for all. Both rows start at the base model, which solves almost no board, and move to the SFT model, which solves most boards with every sample. The bottom row then trains one more SFT epoch with the learning rate decayed to 0 (run 4) while the top row waits, and both rows run GRPO (runs 1 and 6). The bottom row starts GRPO with about half as many orange boards; in both rows most orange boards turn blue during GRPO.
svg.text: 300 validation boards from the base model through SFT and GRPO
Each square is one in-distribution val board, in the same place in every frame. Color: how many of 16 sampled answers solve it.
SFT → SFT with the learning rate decayed to 0 (run 4) → GRPO (run 6)
16 answers per board, sampled at temperature 1. Base model: its evaluation run. The SFT segments were recorded at their start and end only.
All other frames: the in-training evaluations of runs 1 and 6, every 100 GRPO steps, with the same seed each time.
